remaining_bearing_obligations: For fixed 3/2 < sigma < 2, actual affine outputs already have source-independent weighted norm/stability bounds. For continuous sources, normalized first derivatives now have inverse-linear pointwise bounds and L^{2,beta} norm/stability bounds for every beta < 1/2; normalized second derivatives have L^{2,sigma} norm/stability bounds, and actual affine outputs have L^{2,sigma} second derivative norm bounds. Actual first derivatives tend to their forced affine slopes with an O((1+r)^(-1)) bound. Still establish the exact stronger weights or tail asymptotics required by the one-layer source classes, uniformity over varying weight/parameter families, and parameter jets.

Actual center-normalized inversion already exists uniformly on any input positive annulus and compact real parameter set. An actual origin-normalized singular/regular basis is now constructed as well, with exact W=r^(-2) exp(-i r^2/4), uniqueness for its regularized initial data, uniform C1/inverse-Wronskian bounds and Phi=1/r+O(r), Psi=1+O(r^2) value estimates. The Green operator and endpoint conditions in this origin-normalized basis still need actual construction or proved conversion. Actual parameter derivatives and all-order estimates remain verified only for the prior small-annulus, fixed-boundary family. Full Frobenius coefficients/remainders, weighted overlap and actual nonlinear source matching remain open.
